# Measuring

`./ise measure Block` prints volume, surface area, bounds, mass, centre of mass and the inertia tensor about the centre of mass (kg·mm², project axes) with its principal moments, integrated over the solid (exact for flat-faced parts, to the display tolerance on curved ones; inertia needs a material, else the unit-density second moments in mm⁵). `--part Name` measures one part of a multi-part shape; an assembly instance is measured whole. `./ise measure A B` adds centre to centre and the gap between their boxes per axis. Same numbers at GET `/measure/{id}?part=`. In the view, the person measures corners, edges (length; arcs: radius, diameter), faces (area; cylinders: radius) and Alt-clicked parts, and between two picks the closest distance, centre to centre, ΔX ΔY ΔZ and the angle.
